trigger: I am witnessing or recording an arrest
description: What to do if you want to safely record police action happening to you or someone else.

steps.text: Keep a safe distance and do not interfere with what the officers are doing.
You may observe and record events in a public place; this is part of freedom of expression (s.39).
Stay calm if told to stop. Do not fight for your phone, but do not delete your footage.
If asked why you are recording, say: 'I am a bystander recording in a public place.'
If you are the one arrested, you keep your right to grounds, silence, and a lawyer (s.35).
Back up or share the footage with someone you trust as soon as you can.
Note the officers' names, numbers, location, and time.
